content: OpenHands (ex-OpenDevin, v1.7.0 May 2026, ~74k stars) is the closest OSS analogue to ADL. Architecture: controller process runs an observe-think-act loop, spawns a Docker sandbox per task. Repo config lives in .openhands/microagents/ (renamed Skills in V1) with repo.md giving codebase mental model. Ships an SDK separating agent logic / execution environment / interface (CLI, GUI, REST API). Headless mode via REST API; multi-agent subagent spawning. OpenHands Resolver: label a GitHub issue 'fix-me', it sandboxes, edits, runs tests, opens PR. Agent Canvas = self-hosted control center driving Claude Code/Codex/any ACP agent on schedules or webhooks. No behaviour-tester/reviewer gate separation, no pluggable verdict-returning gate stage.
